answer: Sign a vouch for a peer, and that edge starts at weight one and decays five percent weekly unless both ends keep attesting each other. Lose the edge, lose the reachable set, because a vouch counts only while the path to a known seed stays three hops or shorter. Send borderline cases to a second panel, let it re-grade blind, and vest the payout over a hundred epochs so a bought edge has time to rot. Run four hundred clones and decay erases the lattice before the first payout lands: the terrace looks busy, the lotus never opens, the vault stays shut.
